meta.name: SitePulse — Application Architecture
meta.subtitle: Visual Floor Plan Tracker · full-stack map
meta.source: Static analysis of the repo (AGENTS.md, SUPABASE_SCHEMA.md, source tree, migrations).

nodes.label: App Router Pages
nodes.desc: Next.js App-Router entry points: login, dashboard, project workspace, workbench.
nodes.long: The route layer. The project workspace (project/[projectId]) is the central orchestrator that threads data + navigateToView down into each feature view. View navigation is URL-first (?view=<mode>).
rules: View is owned by the ?view= query param; navigateToView() mirrors into useUIStore.viewMode.
Theme is applied once at the root via ThemeApplier in layout.tsx.

nodes.label: App Chrome & Modals
nodes.desc: Header, mobile tab bar, settings, global modals — context-aware controls.
nodes.long: Persistent shell around the views. Header controls (Level selector, Scope tabs, Activities, Export) are gated per-view by a control-visibility matrix; phones navigate via a bottom tab bar.
rules: Header controls gated by controlVisibility(viewMode) in utils/viewRouting.ts — never ad-hoc hide in JSX.

nodes.label: Floorplan Canvas Engine
nodes.desc: Interactive React-Konva map — polygons, stamps, tracing, measure, lag-mode recolor.
nodes.long: The heart of the app. FloorplanCanvas is a thin coordinator; its logic lives in useCanvas*/useTraceTool/useStampTool/useMeasureTools hooks and pure canvasLayout/canvasRecolor utils. Renders three Konva layers: base → units → overlay.
rules: Extend a hook or layer component — do not bloat the coordinator.
Lag-mode recolor happens on copies (recolorForLag); never recolor the write-path array in page.tsx.

nodes.label: Field Status List
nodes.desc: Container/Presenter status list — desktop table + mobile swipe deck, offline staging.
nodes.long: Where field crews log progress. FieldStatusTable (container) calls useFieldData for shared logic, then renders StatusTable (desktop) or the lazy-loaded MobileSwipeDeck (mobile). Rows are memoized; expanded-row audits are viewport-gated.
rules: pendingChanges is intentionally local useState — it feeds the IndexedDB offline queue, don't move it to global state.
LocationRow is React.memo — feed it per-row primitives, never the shared maps.

nodes.label: Schedule Workspace
nodes.desc: Activity manager, cascade planner, Gantt, MS-Project import, baselines.
nodes.long: The single home for building & sequencing a project's activities. Level planned dates flow through a pure level-window engine (ganttMath cascade/reflow + dateRipple FS chaining). Imports MSPDI XML and captures immutable baselines.
rules: Activity editing lives ONLY here (moved out of Settings).
Correctness lives in pure utils (ganttMath, scheduleReconcile, scheduleBaseline) — never forked in components.

nodes.label: Project Dashboard
nodes.desc: FloorPulse rollups, Risk Radar, Type Scorecard, subcontractor benchmarks, forecasts.
nodes.long: All-project analytics. The FloorPulse rail is both the rollup view and the scope control. Confidence bands come from a bootstrap Monte-Carlo layer beside the point-forecast math; forecasts are suppressed (not faked) for thin samples.
rules: Always fetches all-project units/statuses/history.
Forecasts suppressed for small samples & zero pace — keep that honesty.

nodes.label: Look-Ahead Planner
nodes.desc: Self-contained weekly look-ahead module with its own store + persistence.
nodes.long: A near-standalone planning surface (own Zustand session store, own gesture/selection/view libs, own persistence layer) that also reads the project's activities & units.

nodes.label: Workbench (Vectorization)
nodes.desc: Sheet prep — PDF tracing, title-block parse, gridlines, opening detection, review.
nodes.long: The drawing-preparation surface: trace polygons over a PDF, parse title blocks & gridlines, detect openings, and review/label before a sheet goes live.

nodes.label: Taxonomy & Cost Codes
nodes.desc: Governed location subtypes & cost-code library admin panels.
nodes.long: Admin surfaces for the two global governed dictionaries (location subtypes, activity dictionary) plus the estimate cost-code catalog.

nodes.label: Zustand Stores
nodes.desc: Global UI + persisted settings — modularized, hydration-safe.
nodes.long: All floating UI state (active tools, selected units, filters, modals) + persisted settings. Split into focused stores. Persisted props must be read through useHydratedStore to avoid hydration mismatch.
rules: Never use useState/useEffect for global UI state.
viewMode is a read mirror only — never enters TanStack Query.

nodes.label: TanStack Query Hooks
nodes.desc: All server reads/writes — query hooks, mutation actions, realtime cache injection.
nodes.long: The data-access layer. Query hooks fetch; action hooks mutate. Server state is offline-first via a persisted client; realtime cache injections resolve thundering herds. Status writes are idempotent through upsert_status_log / onConflict upserts.
rules: Never use useState/useEffect for DB data.
Slot key is activity_id (not the name); strip synthesized activityName before writes.

nodes.label: Offline Sync Queue
nodes.desc: Offline-first mutation queue persisted to IndexedDB; per-item checkpoint replay.
nodes.long: Durable disconnected mutations. The persister writes the query cache to IndexedDB; a separate project-scoped store persists the pending-changes staging buffer. Sync dequeues per-item so a mid-sync crash only leaves unsynced items.
rules: Everything in the cache must be JSON-serializable — no RBush/Map/Set/DOM.
client_timestamp is stamped at capture time, not sync time.

nodes.label: Pure Logic Library
nodes.desc: Framework-free business math — analytics, scheduling, geometry, forecasting.
nodes.long: ~75 side-effect-free, unit-tested modules that hold the load-bearing invariants: variance analytics, gantt/cascade math, Monte-Carlo forecasting, snapping geometry, auto-advance, status-color language, view routing. Each is the single source of truth for its math.
rules: Single source of truth — never fork the math into components.
Additive forecast layers sit beside progressAnalytics, never fork it.

nodes.label: PDF Render Worker
nodes.desc: Off-main-thread pdf.js rasterization — LOD pyramid + sharp viewport crops.
nodes.long: Renders the floor-plan drawing in a dedicated Web Worker and transfers ImageBitmaps back: a 1×/2× LOD pyramid eagerly, 4× lazily, and debounced sharp crops past deep-zoom. usePdfRenderer is a thin client over an LRU byte cache.
rules: Never call pdf.js page.render on the main thread (janks Konva).
PDF bytes fetched via versioned public URLs (?v=pdf_version) for long-term caching.

nodes.label: Vector Snapping Engine
nodes.desc: RBush spatial index over CAD linework for gravity/corner snapping.
nodes.long: Loads percentage-normalized CAD linework (cache-first, backend fallback) and builds an RBush index for aspect-ratio-aware mathematical snapping while drawing polygons.
rules: Never persist instantiated RBush objects into query cache — return raw JSON, build RBush on the render side.

nodes.label: Supabase Browser Client
nodes.desc: Direct RLS-governed reads/writes, auth session, storage URLs, realtime.
nodes.long: The browser talks to Supabase directly with the publishable (anon) key — Row-Level Security is the enforcement boundary. Handles most CRUD, the upsert_status_log RPC, auth sessions, storage URLs, and realtime channels.
rules: RLS membership policies (join units→sheets→project_members) are the security boundary, not the client.

nodes.label: Backend REST Client
nodes.desc: Typed fetch wrappers to FastAPI — uploads, export, extraction, storage deletes.
nodes.long: Everything the browser can't do directly (PyMuPDF work, PDF export, capped uploads, cascade deletes) goes through these Bearer-JWT fetch calls: exportToPDF, uploadFloorplan, attachOriginal, deleteSheetStorage, deleteProject, extractVectors, extractText.

nodes.label: Server Data Routes
nodes.desc: Privileged Route Handlers using the Supabase service-role key.
nodes.long: Server-only work that needs elevated privileges: creating a project (and enrolling the owner) and provisioning a workbench container. The service-role key never reaches the browser.
rules: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is server-side only.
create_new_project assigns the 'owner' role.

nodes.label: Procore SSO Routes
nodes.desc: OAuth authorize/callback + marketplace deep-link launch; domain-restricted provisioning.
nodes.long: Native Procore SSO: /start builds the authorize URL with a signed state, /callback exchanges the code and auto-provisions domain-allowed users, /launch deep-links a Procore project into its SitePulse canvas.
rules: Nonce cookie + isSafeReturnPath guard against CSRF & open-redirect.

nodes.label: App Assembly
nodes.desc: FastAPI() + lifespan validation + CORS + health route + 4 routers.
nodes.long: main.py is assembly ONLY. The lifespan context manager fails fast if Supabase sub-clients (auth/storage/postgrest) didn't initialize, converting silent import crashes into clear deploy-time errors. `uvicorn main:app` is the deploy entrypoint.
rules: Assembly only — non-route layers live in core/, handlers in routers/.

nodes.label: HTTP Routers
nodes.desc: Full-path handlers — uploads, storage deletes, extraction, PDF export.
nodes.long: Seven endpoints: POST /upload-floorplan, POST /attach-original, DELETE /sheet-storage, DELETE /project, GET /extract-vectors, GET /extract-text, POST /export-pdf. Every route uses Depends(get_current_user).
rules: The `except HTTPException: raise` branch is load-bearing on every route.
User-uploaded bad bytes → 400; a missing/corrupt STORED PDF → 404.
Seam rule: reference shared state by module-attribute lookup (db.supabase, auth.verify_*).

nodes.label: Auth Layer
nodes.desc: Local JWT verification with PyJWT — JWKS/ES256, cached, no network per request.
nodes.long: get_current_user validates the Supabase user JWT locally against the project's JWKS public key (ES256). JWKS is fetched once and cached in a module-level PyJWKClient, so steady-state verification does no network I/O.
rules: Never call supabase.auth.get_user() (caused /extract-vectors 500 timeouts).
No python-jose (CVE-2024-33663); no HS256 fallback without a real secret.

nodes.label: Extraction Layer
nodes.desc: Pure PyMuPDF vector/text parsing + preview & vector compositing.
nodes.long: core/extraction.py is pure fitz (imports no Supabase, env-free). core/sheet_assets.py composites results into storage/cache: render_and_store_preview, cache_sheet_vectors. Output is filtered, 5-decimal-rounded, and capped at VECTOR_CAP_LINES.
rules: Cap + rounding keep the sheet_vectors upsert under the DB's 8s statement_timeout.
Every fitz.open(...) is a `with` block so docs close on error paths.

nodes.label: PDF & Config
nodes.desc: Upload caps, render-pixel clamps, header/color utils, env-derived config.
nodes.long: core/pdf.py holds upload/render safety (read_upload_capped → 413 past MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES; preview_matrix clamps to MAX_RENDER_PIXELS). core/config.py holds env-derived, all-defaulted constants; core/models.py holds Pydantic models.
rules: Never bare `await file.read()` — a client Content-Length can lie.

nodes.label: Supabase Access
nodes.desc: Service-role Supabase client with safe timeouts; PDF download + version bump.
nodes.long: core/supabase_client.py builds the service-role client with SafeClientOptions (25s timeouts, under Render's 30s deadline). Exposes download_original_pdf (translates a missing file to a clean 404) and bump_pdf_version.
rules: Storage writes overwrite in place (upsert:true) — never remove-then-upload.
25s timeouts must stay below Render's 30s platform deadline.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.desc: 30+ RLS-protected tables; event-sourced status + append-only audit.
nodes.long: The system of record. status_logs holds one current-state row per (unit, activity) slot; status_audit_log is the append-only full timeline written by a trigger. RLS anchors on project_members via units→sheets→project.
rules: status_logs = current state; status_audit_log = full history (history hooks read the audit table).
RLS write policies use role in ('owner','admin','pm'); anon is never granted.

nodes.label: RPC & Triggers
nodes.desc: upsert_status_log (idempotent, LWW) + the audit trigger function.
nodes.long: upsert_status_log is the single-mutation write path: SECURITY INVOKER, a Last-Write-Wins timestamp guard, and omit-preserves / present-clears field semantics. fn_status_log_audit writes the audit row on every change.
rules: SECURITY INVOKER — RLS governs writes; anon never granted EXECUTE.
Omit a field to PRESERVE it; send it present (null/'') to CLEAR it.

nodes.label: Storage Buckets
nodes.desc: Public floorplans bucket — original PDFs + server-rendered preview PNGs.
nodes.long: The `floorplans` bucket holds originals/<sheetId>.pdf (source of truth) and converted/<sheetId>.png (a server-rendered preview that doubles as an instant placeholder LOD). Public by design (capability URLs keyed by sheet UUID).
rules: Public by design for the versioned-URL caching pipeline — revisit before sensitive/multi-tenant drawings.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.desc: User identity + sessions; asymmetric ES256-signed JWTs verified via JWKS.
nodes.long: Issues access tokens signed with an asymmetric key (ES256). Both the browser (session) and the FastAPI backend (JWKS public key) verify tokens locally — no per-request network round-trip.

nodes.label: Procore
nodes.desc: Construction platform — SSO/OAuth identity + App-Marketplace deep-linking.
nodes.long: The construction system-of-record SitePulse integrates with: OAuth 2.0 SSO with domain-restricted auto-provisioning, project auto-enrollment, and native deep-linking from the Procore App Marketplace straight into a project canvas.

dataModel.intro: Supabase Postgres is the system of record. Progress tracking is event-sourced: status_logs holds one current-state row per (unit × activity) slot, while status_audit_log is the append-only timeline. Every table is Row-Level-Security protected, anchored on project_members.
dataModel.note: Event sourcing: writes go through the idempotent upsert_status_log RPC (Last-Write-Wins) — never plain INSERT. RLS: read = any project member; write = owner/admin/pm (some tables + superintendent); anon is never granted. * = primary key · → = foreign key.

tables.name: projects
tables.purpose: Top-level project; owner dates + Procore link.

tables.name: sheets
tables.purpose: A drawing/level; holds level×activity plan windows.

tables.name: units
tables.purpose: A location (unit/room) polygon on a sheet.

tables.name: status_logs
tables.purpose: Current state per slot; idempotent LWW upsert.

tables.name: project_contacts
tables.purpose: People on a project (Procore CSV de-dupe).

tables.name: sheet_text / gridlines / metadata
tables.purpose: Per-sheet extraction caches (room-name match, gridlines, title block).

storage.name: floorplans
storage.desc: originals/<sheetId>.pdf (source of truth) + converted/<sheetId>.png (server preview / placeholder LOD). Public capability URLs keyed by sheet UUID; versioned with ?v=pdf_version.

storage.name: upsert_status_log
storage.desc: Single-mutation status write — SECURITY INVOKER, Last-Write-Wins guard, omit-preserves / present-clears field semantics.

storage.name: fn_status_log_audit
storage.desc: Writes an append-only status_audit_log row on every status change (SECURITY DEFINER + fixed search_path).

storage.name: create_new_project
storage.desc: Creates a project and enrolls the caller as 'owner'.

techIntro: A client-heavy Next.js app that talks directly to Supabase (RLS-enforced) for most data, with a thin FastAPI service for the PyMuPDF-heavy PDF work it can't do in the browser.

migrations.name: Status idempotency
migrations.desc: Slot-unique constraint, status_audit_log + trigger, upsert_status_log RPC with LWW guard.

migrations.name: Location taxonomy
migrations.desc: top_level_role + subtype_id + global subtypes dictionary; project_type.

migrations.name: Taxonomy correction
migrations.desc: Backfill / mapping fixes for the taxonomy.

migrations.name: Sheet text
migrations.desc: Cached PDF text for room-name matching.

migrations.name: Activity model (rename+re-key)
migrations.desc: project_milestones→activities; status_logs re-keyed to activity_id; audit + overrides renamed.
